label: Q-01
title: The story-080 DeployMocks rehearsal omits the Antimatter phUSD mint grant that the mainnet script proves load-bearing, and the local verifier never calls autoAnnihilate, so the rehearsal cannot exercise V2's only reward path
fingerprintVerified: sha256(fingerprintBasis) reproduces the stored ledger fingerprint byte-for-byte; copied verbatim from classified-findings.json.
reconciliationSignal: SUPERSEDED by owner triage 2026-09-15 (wont-fix); was: INCOMPLETE-FIX
description: Story 082 names DeployMocks' `_deployAntimatterAndStableStakerV2` + `_rehearseStableStakerCutover` as 'THE TEMPLATE for ordering and assertions'. The mainnet script adds `phUSD.setMinter(antimatter, true)` (Decision 3), because `Antimatter.annihilate` pays its antimatter half with `_phUSD.mint(recipient, amount)`. The executor showed with a negative control that autoAnnihilate otherwise reverts `phUSD: caller is not authorized to mint`. DeployMocks grants only `antimatter.setApprovedMinter(V2)` and `phUSD.setMinter(V2)`. Its local phUSD is `MockPhUSD`, whose `mint` requires `info.canMint && info.mintVersion == mintVersion`. `verify-stable-staker.sh` → `ClaimWithdrawStableStaker.s.sol` asserts `claimEnabled` is false and then withdraws, never calling `autoAnnihilate`. On anvil, the only reward path while `claimEnabled == false` therefore appears to revert, and no local test would notice. Story 082 Decision 3 flagged this as a follow-up, and at 1c1608c it is unfixed.
impact: The local rehearsal and dev environment (UI and integration testing of the V2 reward flow) diverge from mainnet on a load-bearing mint grant. Future edits to the mainnet cutover or V2 reward path get no local signal. The prior run-30 verdict that the V1→V2 exception is 'verified WORKING' did not cover autoAnnihilate. There is no mainnet impact: mainnet preview smoke tests autoAnnihilate, and this audit confirmed all three pools on the fork.
recommendation: Keep the 884ccf8 grant. Extend verify-stable-staker.sh / ClaimWithdrawStableStaker.s.sol with stake -> `evm_increaseTime` (short) -> `autoAnnihilate(token)` on every pool, asserting phUSD received > 0 and Antimatter owed consumed. Once that lands, Q-01 can be proposed `fixed`.
originalRecommendation: In `_deployAntimatterAndStableStakerV2`, add `phUSD.setMinter(address(antimatter), true)` with a read-back at the current mintVersion. Extend `verify-stable-staker.sh` / `ClaimWithdrawStableStaker.s.sol` with a stake + `evm_increaseTime` (short) + `autoAnnihilate` step that asserts phUSD received > 0 and Antimatter owed was consumed. First confirm by running the story-080 dev rehearsal and calling autoAnnihilate on anvil; record the exact revert string.
evidence: git diff 1c1608c 884ccf8 -- script/DeployMocks.s.sol (L1897-1906 grant added, L1790 ACL assert added); `git diff --stat` shows verify-stable-staker.sh and script/interactions/ unchanged; `grep autoAnnihilate` in ClaimWithdrawStableStaker.s.sol only hits comments/log text (L24, L106).
run32Observation: run-32 (884ccf8) INCOMPLETE FIX: 884ccf8 (untagged) adds `phUSD.setMinter(address(antimatter), true)` + `_requireLiveMinter(antimatter)` to DeployMocks (L1897-1906, ACL assert L1790) - the grant limb is fixed. verify-stable-staker.sh and script/interactions/ClaimWithdrawStableStaker.s.sol are unchanged 1c1608c..884ccf8; `autoAnnihilate` appears there only in a comment (L24) and a log string (L106). No local script or test calls autoAnnihilate, so a regression of the grant would again go unnoticed locally. Status stays open; do NOT propose fixed until the verifier exercises autoAnnihilate.
